Mr. Smith paid $5.50 to Dr. Jones on the 21st of May, 1999 — “a bargain,” she said…[12]
In 2005 the 3rd edition sold 12,000 copies (about 50% of the print run); e.g. the U.S. market.
Temperatures reached 30° & rising. St. Mary's Mt. Everest vs. the “Great” Northern Railway.
Prof. Ada wrote: “It works.” Then 42 people left. The 2nd day, 1st place, 100th time.

A new paragraph, with an en–dash and a soft­hyphen and a non breaking space.
He whispered ‘quietly’ and it cost £3 — not $3! Really? Yes. “Absolutely.” (Indeed.)
